content.text: {"id": "mm5723a2", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "All six patients reported bloody diarrhea; three (50%) were hospitalized."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Exposure to raw milk was similarly low (3%) among Californians who responded to a population survey"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "All six patients reported bloody diarrhea; three (50%) were hospitalized."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "standard aerobic plate counts and coliform counts of collected samples with code dates of September 17 through October 9, 2006, were indicative of contamination"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "three (50%) were hospitalized."}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Exposure to raw milk was similarly low (3%) among Californians who responded to a population survey"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "California standards limit standard plate counts for raw and pasteurized milk to 15,000 CFU/mL"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "outbreak investigation", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "This report summarizes the investigation of these cases by CDPH"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Case finding was conducted by notifying all California local health departments and infection-control practitioners"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Using purchase information supplied by the patients' families, investigators determined that the patients consumed raw milk"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "CDPH epidemiologists reviewed exposure histories for the 50 most recent E. coli O157:H7 cases reported to CDPH during 2004--2006"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "were tested for aerobic microflora, total coliform, fecal coliform, and E. coli O157:H7."}], "confidence": "high", "uncertain_fields": []}
